card.name: The pronoun it starting a clause
card.fires_on: The word "it" (or "It") as a subject pronoun that starts a new clause or sentence, often after "unless", "because" or a full stop. It refers back to a thing just mentioned, such as a document, information or a condition.

modes.label: It after a conjunction
modes.description: Lowercase "it" following "unless" or "because", then a verb like "is".
modes.example: discontinue captopril, unless<< it>> is considered lifesaving for the mother.

modes.label: Sentence-initial It
modes.description: Capitalized "It" opening a sentence about information or a condition just described.
modes.example: This information is for reference purposes only.<< It>> was current when produced and may now be

modes.label: It as object
modes.description: "it" as the object of a verb like share.
modes.example: Please spread the word. Share<< it>> with your friends/family.
